newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Friday, helped by the yen's weakness against the dollar and higher prices for other commodities in Japan, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 3.4 yen per kg up. Benchmark January was up 1.9 yen at 123.4 yen.
"Gains in other commodity prices and a further slip in the yen lifted market sentiment," one trader said.
The market saw profit-taking selling ahead of the close after the benchmark broke above 125 yen. "The benchmark January will again test resistance at 126 yen next week," he said.
